item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.32)] VSE Corporation earnings beat by $0.82, revenue topped estimates
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.32)
VSE Corporation (NASDAQ: VSEC) reported strong second-quarter results, beating analyst estimates for both earnings per share (EPS) and revenue. The company posted an EPS of $1.75, significantly higher than the estimated $0.93, and revenue of $449.1 million, exceeding the consensus of $427.57 million. VSE's stock has shown positive performance, rising 11.76% in the last three months and 39.00% over the past year.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.33)] Q2 2026 NiSource Inc Earnings Call Transcript
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.33)
NiSource Inc. (NYSE:NI) released its Q2 2026 earnings call transcript, reaffirming its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $2.2 to $2.7 per share and long-term growth rates of 6% to 8% through 2030. The company secured regulatory approvals for significant data center agreements, which are expected to provide substantial bill relief for customers and contribute to future growth. Despite these positives, Q2 adjusted EPS was lower than the prior year due to higher operations and maintenance costs from severe weather and union negotiations, and the company faces regulatory challenges regarding gas modernization investments and affordability discussions in Indiana.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.30)] Power Integrations Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
item.description:

The company highlighted growth across all end markets, particularly industrial and automotive, and unveiled new 2,200-volt PowiGaN technology for future high-voltage applications in data centers and EVs. Power Integrations provided a positive outlook for Q3, expecting continued revenue growth and further reductions in channel inventory, while focusing on long-term growth in high-power markets.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.71)] Nokia Acquires NXP's Arizona Fab to Secure AI Data Center Optical Chip Supply
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.71)
Nokia has acquired NXP Semiconductors' chip fabrication plant in Chandler, Arizona, to convert it into a production line for indium phosphide (InP) optical chips, crucial for AI data centers. This strategic move addresses the severe shortage of InP chips and aims to transform Nokia into a major AI infrastructure player. The acquisition is expected to close in Q1 2029, and analysts project significant growth for Nokia in the North American optical networking market.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.22)] Tenable Advances Exposure Management with Coverage Across Every Major AI Platform and Developer Tool
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.22)
Tenable Holdings, Inc. has announced enhanced AI security capabilities within its Tenable One Exposure Management Platform, expanding coverage to include Google Gemini and other major LLMs, Model Context Protocols, and AI-native IDE tools. This aims to address the critical AI exposure gap created by rapid AI adoption, allowing security teams to gain a more complete view of AI usage, associated risks, and necessary actions. The platform identifies and secures AI environments, helping organizations govern AI use, enforce policies, and prevent cyber exposures, while also using AI to improve security operations.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.10), NVDA Neutral (+0.13)] Can Microchip Technology’s (MCHP) PCIe Gen 6 Storage Fabric Prototype Reframe Its Data Center Narrative?
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.10), NVDA Neutral (+0.13)
Microchip Technology recently showcased a PCIe Gen 6 storage fabric prototype at the 2026 Future of Memory and Storage Conference, highlighting its potential to enhance AI, HPC, and cloud data center workloads. This development, which links Microchip's Switchtec Gen 6 switches with Micron NVMe SSDs, is aimed at improving bandwidth and latency. While this strengthens Microchip's AI and data center narrative, investors are still keenly watching its upcoming Q1 2027 earnings for updates on inventory normalization and debt management, alongside the actual impact of these AI-focused initiatives on orders and margins.

item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.11)] Bitcoin Is Down 44%, and BlackRock Just Launched a Fund That Pays You to Wait
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.11)
BlackRock has launched a new ETF, BITA, which offers investors a way to earn income while holding Bitcoin exposure, contrasting with its existing IBIT fund that directly tracks Bitcoin's price. While IBIT mirrors Bitcoin's 44% decline without income, BITA uses a covered-call strategy to generate monthly distributions, estimated at $9.59 per share annually. This allows investors to mitigate losses during Bitcoin downturns and get paid to wait for a recovery, though it caps some of the potential upside during sharp rallies.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] Storage architecture focus at Supermicro Summit

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.21)] Tyler Technologies (TYL) Lands Tennessee Statewide Cloud Tax Migration
item.description:

This project, running on Amazon Web Services, is highlighted as a significant move for public agencies shifting core tax systems to the cloud, aligning with the broader adoption of SaaS in government. item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12)] LendingTree tests ChatGPT as a new channel for mortgage customer acquisition
item.description:

This tool aids in the research phase by letting users input financial details to understand rate influences, then directing them to LendingTree's marketplace for personalized offers. This initiative positions LendingTree as an early adopter in leveraging conversational AI for customer acquisition in financial services, offering an opportunity to refine the consumer experience and gain insights before competitors.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (-0.15)] Etsy to Cut 220 Jobs, or 12% of Workforce, in Restructuring Push; Authorizes $2 Billion Buyback
item.description:

This announcement coincides with Etsy's second-quarter results, which showed sales exceeding estimates and an adjusted loss partly due to the Reverb divestiture. The company also authorized a new $2 billion stock buyback program, following recent divestitures of Depop and Reverb to focus on its core handmade marketplace amidst intense competition.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (-0.10)] Etsy laying off 12% of staff in bid to streamline business, position for growth
item.description:

Despite a net loss for the quarter due to discontinued operations, Etsy reported stronger-than-expected sales and raised its full-year guidance for gross merchandise sales.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.20)] Veeco receives order for LUMINA+ MOCVD system for InP lasers
item.description:

This order reinforces Veeco's strong position in high-volume arsenide/phosphide production, with InP lasers being crucial for optical transceivers in data center connectivity.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.33), MSFT Bullish (+0.33), NVDA Bullish (+0.32)] Schwab Emerging Markets ETF vs State Street Climate Fund: Do Emerging Markets or Climate Stocks Offer Better Growth in 2026?

item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.24)] How MP Materials (NYSE:MP) Connects to the Electrification Wave?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.24)
MP Materials (NYSE:MP) is gaining attention due to the rising demand for metals essential in electric vehicles, data centers, and power grids, linking the company directly to the broad electrification trend. The company produces rare earth materials used in high-performance magnets and is expanding into magnet production itself. Rare earth materials are crucial for electric motors, generators, and electronic devices, making them vital for advancing electrified transportation, computing, and power infrastructure.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Neutral (+0.14)] Oracle Multi-VM Autonomous Database lands on Exadata systems
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.11), AMZN Neutral (+0.14)
Oracle has expanded its Exadata Cloud at Customer service with a new Multi-VM Autonomous Database feature, allowing organizations to run both autonomous and non-autonomous Oracle databases on the same hardware. This virtualization, based on KVM hypervisor clustering, addresses customer demand for integrated database environments and simplifies data management while accelerating transitions to the cloud. The move provides a full self-service database cloud option within customer data centers, enhancing flexibility and potentially reducing costs.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.31)] Silicon Labs Delivers its Lowest-Power Bluetooth LE SoC
item.description:

Silicon Labs has introduced the BG2B, a Series 2 Bluetooth Low Energy (LE) wireless SoC, designed to extend battery life and enhance capabilities for battery-powered IoT devices. The BG2B offers the lowest power consumption in Silicon Labs’ Bluetooth LE portfolio, with improved efficiency across various operational modes. It also integrates advanced security features like Secure Vault, along with numerous peripherals such as CAN-FD, LED drivers, and dual ADCs, reducing bill-of-materials cost and enabling new applications in smart homes, industrial monitoring, and vehicle diagnostics.

item.description:

Given the intense competition and a stretched valuation, the stock currently holds a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell), suggesting investors avoid it for now.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.30)] AI open letters shift from warnings to push for business action
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.30)
A recent open letter, "We Must Act Now," signed by over 200 economists and AI experts, marks a shift in the AI discussion from abstract warnings to actionable concerns about workplace transformation and economic impact. Unlike previous letters that focused on ethical or safety risks, this statement emphasizes potential large-scale job displacement and calls for businesses and policymakers to build "incentives, guardrails, and institutions" to manage AI's deployment. The article suggests that businesses should proactively measure AI's productivity, invest in reskilling, and design AI deployments to augment, rather than replace, human roles.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.11)] Alphabet Is Still Up 16% in 2026. What Will It Take to Get GOOGL Stock Above $400?

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.31), AMZN Bullish (+0.34)] The Power of Predictive Analytics
item.description:

The Thornburg International Growth ETF (TXUG) focuses on non-U.S. companies with strong earnings growth without the high debt burden.

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.64)] Deadline Alert: Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) Shareholders
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.64)
Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP is urging Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) shareholders who suffered losses to contact them regarding a securities fraud lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Microsoft made misleading statements and failed to disclose issues related to its Copilot AI products, increased capital expenditures for AI, and slower-than-expected Azure growth, causing a significant drop in stock price on January 29, 2026.
